App.//: Public base URL used for links in emails (franchise approval, password reset). Set to your production URL on deploy.

Payments.//: ReconciliationDryRun=true makes Payment Status Sync + Webhook Reconciliation POLL and REPORT only: no settlement, no invoice, no enrollment, no email, no commission, no status change, no audit row. Keep it TRUE whenever this app points at a restored backup, a demo copy, or any database whose orders must not be acted on. Set it to FALSE only against the real live database, and only when you intend historical pending orders to be settled automatically.
